messages:
Ellen: hey team — can someone kick off a quick smoke + throughput bench for strata-7b-lite? we want basic perf (p50/p95 token latency), peak tokens/sec, and a memory profile. low-effort, just enough to validate serving config. target infra: a100-80gb, single-gpu.
Mike: +1. what's the sample mix? short chat + medium prompt?
Ellen: yes: 1) chat: 32 tokens ctx, 2) doc+qa: 512 prompt + 128 gen, 3) streaming long tail: 1024 ctx with 64 token bursts. run 1000 inferences each mode if feasible.
Sophia: I can queue this later today. which model repo/tag should I pull?
Ellen: use model: redwood/strata-7b-lite:v1.2.0 (quantized PTQ int8 config). add flag --kv-cache=true.
Kevin: note: last time this family had a tail-latency bump at seq>800 if attention tiling wasn't enabled. please enable tiling in the runtime flags: --attn-tiling=auto and include kernel debug traces.
bench-bot: job queued: job_id=jb_2026_311_42, queued_by=Sophia, infra=a100-80gb-1, expected_run=30m. logs -> s3://redwood-bench/strata-7b-lite/jb_2026_311_42/
Mike: can we also capture cost-estimates? rough per-token cost is helpful for product to decide default route.
Ana: adding: include token-cost calc in results (tokens, GPU-time secs, est $/1M tokens). I have the cost table — will add to analysis.
Sophia: running now. will post smoke pass + attached artifacts: perf.json, flamegraph.svg, and a small analysis.md.
Kevin: pinging eng-runtime-ops: if tiling triggers a runtime fallback, please annotate in the run notes.
Ellen: thanks. if smoke looks good we'll publish quick-summary and request a canary push to dedicated pool tomorrow.
Sophia: smoke done: small failures on mode(3) where p99 spiked ~1.8x. attaching short logs. s3://redwood-bench/strata-7b-lite/jb_2026_311_42/artifacts/
Sophia: brief findings:
- mode1 (chat 32): p50=10ms, p95=28ms, tokens/sec steady=1900
- mode2 (512+128): p50=45ms, p95=110ms, tokens/sec steady=420
- mode3 (1024 ctx bursts): p50=78ms, p95=640ms (p99 spikes), memory cursor at 76GB during peak
Kevin: looks like tiling wasn't applied correctly for mode3; the kernel selector fell back to non-optimized path due to sequence alignment bug. I'll open a tiny PR to fix alignment check.
Ellen: thanks Kevin. Sophia — can you re-run with the debug kernel logs enabled once PR is merged?
Sophia: yep. scheduling re-run after Kevin's PR lands. ETA ~2 hours.
Ana: I've computed est cost: total GPU-time=2.3h across runs -> est $/1M tokens = $14.8 (using current reserved rates). adding to analysis.md.
Mike: good quick snapshot. action items: 1) Kevin PR to fix alignment (owner Kevin), 2) Sophia re-run + publish artifacts (owner Sophia), 3) Ellen to prep canary request if re-run clears.
Ellen: I'll draft canary request template and post here once re-run green. thanks all :rocket:
bench-bot: job jb_2026_311_42 status=completed (partial failures in mode3). artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/strata-7b-lite/jb_2026_311_42/artifacts/
Sophia: final note: added a short evlauation set to ensure quality unchanged — no regressions observed. will include comparison table in final summary.
Ellen: perfect. closing thread for now, will re-open if re-run surfaces anything else.
